  THE CENSUS. Zero modules import both a chart seam and any rep producer --   
  all twelve pairs are 0:                                                     
   seams     Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree, Pic0SigmaSheaf,                         
  Pic0ChartRestrictedFibre, Pic0ChartVMonotone                                
   producers DivRepAffPullClause, DivRepChartRange, DivRepGlobalClassify      
  The seam's closure is 323 modules and contains none of the three. So no     
  #check, build or LSP query had ever held the two halves at once.            
                                                                              
  WHY IT MATTERS. Every board row prices the route as three undischarged      
  antecedents; none prices the JOIN, because from inside either half there    
  is nothing to see. An unelaborated composition is where a carrier mismatch  
  hides ('price the consumer's carrier').                                     
                                                                              
  THE RESULT -- they fit.                                                     
   1. mixedParamRepresentableBy accepts a PRODUCED rep at the carrier, not    
  just a hypothesis. Probed with PUnit.{u+1} at the producer's single         
  parameter g. EXIT=0.

  mentioned in no producer file, is FREE by instance resolution from          
  GeometricallyIrreducible + IsProper + SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1. Probed   
  standalone, EXIT=0. Not an extra obligation, though it looks like one from  
  the producer side.                                                          
                                                                              
  TWO REAL CONSTRAINTS, cheap but not guessable:                              
   * `iota : Type u`, NOT Type 0 -- a Unit-indexed atlas fails to unify at    
  the V argument; PUnit.{u+1} works.                                          
   * `IsFinite pi` SUBSUMES `IsAffineHom pi` (overlappingInstances fires).    
  Producers bind the former, the seam the latter.

  producers are ALL conditional (_of_chartClause / _of_id / _of_chartRange),  
  gated on U2 / the G-4 certificate; huniv and hcov have no producer at any   
  V but the two refuted endpoints. Established: THE PLUMBING IS NOT A COST.   
  The remaining price is entirely in the three antecedents, and a lane        
  discharging one owes no carrier-transport or instance-bridging lemma. A     
  subtraction from the cost of finishing, not a step toward it.

  IsSeparated X.hom. The seam's four-input paragraph, roadmap                 
  AJC.picrep.etale-rep + its three children, and ajc-p2's descent-assembly

  @IsSeparated; the diagonal route via

  @IsClosedImmersion is ALSO absent (IsClosedImmersion is no                  
  HasRingHomProperty, so descendsAlong_flat is inapplicable). Exactly five    
  scheme flat-descent instances exist: LocallyOfFiniteType,                   
  LocallyOfFinitePresentation, Smooth, FormallyUnramified, Etale              
  (Morphisms/LocalFlatDescent.lean:35-47).                                    
                                                                              
  Free anyway, never needing to descend: picEt is CommGrpCat-valued, so ANY   
  representing scheme is a group object by Yoneda transport                   
  (CommGrpObj.ofRepresentableBy X (picEtCommGrp C) (rep.ofIso                 
  (picEtCommGrpForgetIso C))), and a group scheme over a field is separated.  
  From (rep : (PicScheme.picEt C).RepresentableBy X) alone, IsSeparated       
  X.hom is a theorem -- and [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] is UNUSED           
  (linter-flagged).                                                           
                                                                              
  THE BRICK IS A PORT. Mathlib lacks 'group scheme over a field is            
  separated': infer_instance for IsSeparated G.hom at [GrpObj G] over Spec K  
  FAILS while IsClosedImmersion eta[G].left SYNTHESIZES. AJCR has it --       
  GrpObj.isPullback_diagonal + isSeparated_of_isClosedImmersion_one +         
  instance isSeparated_of_grpObj, AbelianVariety/GroupSeparated.lean, 121     
  lines sorry-free. AJC has none of the three names. I transcribed the two    
  load-bearing ones; they compiled UNCHANGED.                                 
                                                                              
  RESULT 2: LocallyOfFiniteType descends free. At the real cover (k'/k,       
  [Module.Finite], [Algebra.IsSeparable]) Spec.map (algebraMap k k') is       
  Surjective, Flat, QuasiCompact all by inferInstance, so                     
  of_pullback_fst_of_descendsAlong closes it.                                 
                                                                              
  CONSEQUENCE: the assembly needs only the representability field. NOT a      
  discount on the seam -- k'-side representability is still the campaign's    
  undischarged output.
